scientific_integrity: A proof is presented, a standalone checker independently implements the stated formulas, and the available primary full texts were reviewed. No independent verification or exhaustive literature certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: All statements concern the explicitly defined full-plane state map, not only the original numerical initial slice w=0; period-two means literal two-step return, modulo only exact 2π/k accumulator translations. Higher-period orbits, bounded-amplitude complete stability, and global basins are not classified. Finite checks are illustrative, not infinite proof. Prior-publication priority may be affected by unindexed analyses.
title: Infinite repelling two-cycles and their sharp density in a cosine-memory logistic map
